# servfail_zones (Data Source)

Lists the zones you own or that are shared with you on a given `server_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List every zone on a server (server_id is required here)
data "servfail_zones" "all" {
  server_id = "sakamoto.pl."
}

output "all_zone_names" {
  value = [for z in data.servfail_zones.all.zones : z.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) Primary nameserver to list zones from, with trailing dot (e.g. `ns1.famfo.xyz.`). Find it in a zone's SOA MNAME or the web UI; an unknown id returns an empty list, not an error.

### Read-Only

- `zones` (Attributes List) The zones on the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `dnssec` (Boolean) Whether DNSSEC-signed.
- `kind` (String) Zone kind.
- `name` (String) Zone name.
- `serial` (Number) SOA serial.
